purpose: Candidate QE PBE pseudopotential selection for the BTO cross-calculator validation; not an executable production manifest.

proposed_bto_run_settings.rationale: 100 Ry preserves the project BTO wavefunction-cutoff target; 600 Ry is the largest SSSP precision density-cutoff recommendation among Ba, Ti and O.

activation_requirements: Explicit user approval of this mixed-family SSSP collection for the BTO benchmark.
Acquire UPF files from their reviewed source without renaming them.
Verify every MD5 locally on hf before the one-rank QE preflight.
Run a BTO QE cutoff-convergence check before interpreting a production VCNEB path.
